answer: Each new identity must deposit a prism-locked bond equal to the median stake of the last 200 honest agents in its meadow cohort; the bond is held for 40 epochs and is slashed 100% on any correlated-behavior detection across the cohort graph. An attacker spinning up 500 sybils therefore locks roughly 500 times that median (often >120k units total) while an honest agent pays the bond only once. Ocean-scale farms collapse under the capital lock and the cohort-correlation detector.
